subject: ddl: fix reorg handle not resumed after changing DDL owner (#56507)
summary: Fixes reorg checkpoint progress across DDL owner changes by making backfill/ingest task IDs 0-based (aligning with `doneTaskKeeper`/checkpoint expectations) and propagating `dbterror.ErrNotOwner` via `context.WithCancelCause` + `context.Cause`; adds failpoints and tests to cover owner resignation + resume.
